decision: Hand-write git codec, drop @cloudflare/computer git client
reason: writeTree/writeCommit bundled but never exported; commit() needs a working tree

decision: Real facet tests, not stubs
reason: facets+worker loader run locally in workerd with no paid account

decision: Replay rescoped to executor-compatibility gate
reason: replaying old-prompt tapes passes prompt-only candidates vacuously

decision: Promotion consumes an attestation
reason: CAS stops double-promote but not stale validation evidence (TOCTOU)

decision: Ratchet needs mandatory canaries
reason: empty or all-failing corpus makes ratchet vacuously permit everything

decision: GC deferred
reason: 10GB/DO means no pressure; bad root discovery destroys rollback

decision: Facet isolation moved first
reason: load-bearing claim; failing late invalidates everything above it
result: adopted as D2b, new slice S0.5

decision: Keep git-exact byte format
reason: mutation test: padding mode to 040000 makes the git hash-object oracle fail

decision: Codec rejects gpgsig/encoding commit headers
reason: fixed domain types cannot represent them; we author every commit ourselves
result: accepted, noted as a limit on decoding foreign commits

decision: Conformance suite is the deliverable, not MemoryStore
reason: S9 reruns it verbatim against DO SQLite; stops the two impls diverging
evidence: mutation test: yielding between compare and write gives 16 CAS winners, suite fails

decision: Brand via type predicate, not `as` assertion
reason: no-unsafe-type-assertion; matches parseSha idiom already in git/types.ts

decision: All 5 facet isolation claims hold
reason: storage separate, env empty, egress blocked, routes unreachable, reset survives load+init failure

decision: Split tsconfig: node-side vs workers-side
reason: @cloudflare/workers-types globally replaces Node lib types; one program cannot host both
evidence: tsc errors on crypto and TextDecoder in src/git after merge

decision: Lineage cycle guard kept though untestable
reason: content addressing makes a real cycle unconstructable (child sha embeds parent sha); guard defends a corrupted store
evidence: visited-set in lineage.ts and read.ts, no test

decision: Rollback needs no attestation; promote does
reason: rolling back to a previously-live known-good generation is a different risk profile; unable-to-recover-because-validation-unavailable is the worse failure

decision: DO SQLite passes the unmodified conformance suite
reason: single conditional UPDATE for CAS (no read-then-write window); transactionSync for schema+pointer init
evidence: 8 conformance tests vs real workerd SQLite
result: merged, impls held to one definition

decision: Corpus and gate versions are content-derived hashes
reason: a constant string nobody bumps makes the attestation binding meaningless
evidence: corpus hash covers case content, sessions, canary markings

decision: Four-primitive action space is compiler-enforced
reason: an agent that can add tools can add one that escapes; a comment would not stop it
evidence: mutation: adding a 5th union member fails typecheck at assertNever (TS2345 not assignable to never)

decision: edit requires exactly one exact match
reason: silent no-op means the agent believes it rewrote its own policy when it did not; invisible for generations
evidence: no-match and ambiguous-match are distinct typed failures

decision: Reset retry bounded at 16 attempts with a typed contended outcome
reason: unbounded while(true) inside a DO wedges the request instead of failing it; the escape hatch would be unobservably stuck exactly when needed
evidence: review of merged S5 code, new test test/genesis/reset-bounded.test.ts

decision: Supervisor duplicated genesis seeding and reset
reason: S10 worktree branched before S5 landed, so genesis.ts did not exist there
evidence: two escape-hatch impls; supervisor uses genesis_sha meta row and its own reset

decision: Vertical path composes with no failed seams
reason: seed gen0, pinned turn, candidate, real gate, attested promote, rollback, reset all compose

decision: No production agent loop yet maps generation modules to the replay loop and four tools
reason: integration test supplies a scripted executor; real runtime is a genuine remaining gap

decision: Genesis unified on src/generation/genesis.ts
reason: supervisor now seeds via seedGenesis and holds a real GenesisPin; meta row only persists which sha is genesis
evidence: resetToGenesisSync added so bounded CAS survives inside transactionSync; 140 tests green

decision: Attestation provenance is the top gap
reason: bindings close TOCTOU only if attestations come from an authenticated independent validator; routes are unauthenticated so one can be fabricated

decision: Gate and live execution must share one executor
reason: otherwise compatibility validation tests a surrogate forever

decision: Canaries pinned in supervisor-owned state, outside the corpus
reason: canary identity previously came from the mutable corpus, so a candidate could decide which cases were mandatory
evidence: test: candidate removing the canary catching its own regression cannot promote

decision: Gate and live execution share one AgentExecutor behind two response sources
reason: otherwise compatibility validation tests a surrogate forever
evidence: test: same executor and effects under recorded and live sources; integration now uses the real executor

decision: Manifest convention: prompt.md and policy.md required, skills/*.md
reason: missing required module must fail loudly, not run with a silently empty prompt
evidence: AgentMaterializationError with the missing module named

decision: Test credential moved from .dev.vars into vitest.workers.config miniflare bindings
reason: .dev.vars is gitignored, so 11 workers tests passed in the agent worktree and failed on main
evidence: 401 unauthorized on merge; fixed and reproducible from a clean clone
